messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to run migration users_schema_v2 tomorrow 2026-03-18 22:00 UTC. Proposed dual-write window 22:00-22:30 UTC. I intend to kick off the migration and monitor smoke. Need a deploy owner and a rollback owner. Smoke checklist is below.

chris: I can take deploy owner. I’ll be online 21:30–23:30 UTC.

devon: I can be rollback owner and handle DB rollback steps if needed. Will be reachable on phone.

maria: Awesome — tagging that: @chris deploy owner, @devon rollback owner. Jess, can you take smoke validation and post the checks once done?

jess: Yep — I’ll run smoke from EU region and share quick results. Plan is to run the post-migration smoke suite (user read/write, auth, profile reads).

maria: Copy. Quick reminder of rollout plan:
- 21:30 UTC: warmup and prechecks (db connections, replication lag < 3s)
- 22:00 UTC: enable dual-write (app flag) and start migration job (fast-backfill for new columns)
- 22:00–22:30 UTC: monitor errors, prefix cache warming, qps throttling if needed
- 22:30 UTC: if no regressions, flip read traffic to new schema alias. If issues, rollback per plan.

maria: Smoke checklist (short):
```
# pre-migration
SELECT now();
SELECT pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp(); -- check replication
# post-migration smoke (sample)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/users -d '{"email":"smoke+1@redwood.test"}'
psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE migrated_v2 = true;"
```

chris: Adding operational notes — watch for these metrics during window:
- write error rate > 0.5%
- replica lag > 5s
- p95 latency spike on /users > 300ms
If any trigger, pause backfill and evaluate.

deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2026-03-18 22:00–22:45 UTC. Creator: maria. Auto-reminder 15m prior.

jess: I’ll post the smoke steps I run (minimal, quick) 15m before start and then results after 22:05.

devon: Rollback plan summary:
1) Pause migration job (control plane).
2) Switch app flag to disable writes to new columns (app-side dual-write off).
3) Run small patch to convert reads back to old view.
4) If schema changes applied (DDL) are reversible, run reverse DDL; otherwise keep new columns but stop using them and schedule fix.
Note: full DB restore is last resort and needs SRE.

maria: Good. Chris — can you confirm you have the migration job runbook and the kill-switch commands handy?

chris: Yep, I have runbook link and the kill-switch alias: `infra migrate cancel users_schema_v2 --force`. Also have the app flag toggles in the ops repo.

sre-oncall: If you need intervention for replica lag or node restarts, ping me. I’ll be on standby 21:45–23:00 UTC.

jess: Prechecks done at 21:40 UTC: replication lag 0.8s, p99 latency normal, no outstanding deploys. Will recheck at 21:55.

maria: Thanks — last question: are we expecting any long-running backfill (>15m)? Chris?

chris: Fast-backfill should complete within window for the typical shards; a small tail may persist. We’ll scope backfill parallelism so it doesn't saturate writers. If backfill runs longer, we keep dual-write for an extra hour and monitor.

devon: If tail exceeds 1h we should schedule a follow-up slot and not force a rollback unless production errors increase.

maria: OK. Final checklist before I schedule on calendar:
- Deploy owner: chris ✅
- Rollback owner: devon ✅
- Smoke owner: jess ✅
- SRE standby: sre-oncall ✅
- Deploy window: 2026-03-18 22:00–22:30 UTC (with 22:30–23:30 contingency) ✅

chris: I’ll create the actual run command and post it in this thread 10m before start.

jess: 21:55 recheck: replication lag 0.6s, no recent errors, all good to go.

maria: Perfect. Thanks team — I’ll pin the runbook link and set calendar invite. See you in the channel 10m before window. :thumbsup:
